title: Taiwan faces alarming Chinese presence around its territory
summary_full: Taiwan reported significant Chinese military incursions around its territory on Saturday.  Up to twenty Chinese aircraft and several naval vessels were detected by Taiwan's defense ministry.  Many of these aircraft crossed the median line into Taiwan's air defense zone.  This surge follows recent days of increased Chinese naval and air presence.  Taiwan's Coast Guard Administration noted a substantial rise in Chinese vessels last month.
